title: Probe-Geometry Alignment: Erasing the Cross-Sequence Memorization Signature Below Chance
abstract: arXiv:2605.01699v4 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Recent attacks show that behavioural unlearning of large language models leaves internal traces recoverable by adversarial probes. We characterise where this retention lives and show it can be surgically removed without measurable capability cost. Our central protocol is a leave-one-out cross-sequence probe that tests whether a memorisation signature generalises across held-out sequences. The signature is real and consistent across scale: memorisation-specific gaps of +0.32, +0.19, +0.30 on Pythia-70M, GPT-2 medium, and Mistral-7B; on Pythia-70M, the random-initialisation control collapses to -0.04 at the deepest layer where the pretrained signature peaks. translated_title: 探针几何对齐：将跨序列记忆化特征擦除至低于随机水平
translated_abstract: 近期的攻击研究表明，大语言模型的行为级遗忘会在模型内部留下可被对抗性探针恢复的痕迹。我们刻画了这种残留信息的所在位置，并证明可以在不产生可测量能力损失的情况下将其精准移除。我们的核心协议是一种留一法跨序列探针，用于检验记忆化特征能否泛化到留出的序列上。该特征真实存在且在不同模型规模上保持一致：在Pythia-70M、GPT-2 medium和Mistral-7B上，记忆化特异性差距分别为+0.32、+0.19、+0.30；在Pythia-70M上，随机初始化对照组在预训练特征达到峰值的 deepest 层（最深层）处降至-0.04。该探针方向与召回能力在因果上可分离——将其投影消除后，局部特征坍缩（+0.44 -> -0.19），而行为级召回几乎不变——并且在自然记忆内容上训练的探针无法分类通过微调注入的秘密信息，这标志着两种表示（此处摘要原文被截断）
tldr: 该研究定位了大语言模型遗忘后残留记忆化特征的内部位置，并提出探针几何对齐方法，可在不损失模型能力的前提下将跨序列记忆化特征擦除至低于随机水平。
en_tdlr: This work localizes where memorization signatures persist inside LLMs after unlearning and shows that probe-geometry alignment can surgically erase the cross-sequence memorization signature below chance level without measurable capability cost.
